name: Cinema Bass (BEQ)
description: Restores theatrical bass impact lost in home releases. Based on the X-curve standard where LFE is mixed +10 dB hot in cinemas. Home masters often compress this dynamic range. Popular in the BEQ community (beqdesigner, miniDSP users). Best for movie-watching — can be fatiguing for music. Note: achieving the full +10 dB rise requires room gain and headroom — the calibration system anchors reference level to minimize boost, using cuts above 40 Hz rather than boosting the deep bass.
